verniz-uv-base.short: Anchoring and leveling before vacuum metallization.
verniz-uv-base.h1: UV Base Coat for vacuum metallization on ABS, PP, PS and Zamak
verniz-uv-base.title: UV Base Coat for vacuum metallization | Corquímica
verniz-uv-base.meta: UV Base Coat for ABS, PP, PS, Zamak and TPU. Excellent adhesion, leveling and cure in seconds. Request a sample and technical data sheet.
verniz-uv-base.def: The UV Base Coat is the first layer applied to the part before vacuum metallization. It anchors the metallization, levels the surface and provides the mirror finish that the Top Coat will later protect. For flexible TPU parts, Corquímica offers the UV Base Coat Flex.

faq: What is a UV base coat?
It is the coating applied before vacuum metallization. It gives the part adhesion and leveling, and prepares the surface to receive the metallization and then the Top Coat.
What is the difference between a base coat and a top coat?
The base coat sits under the metallization and anchors it. The top coat sits over the metallization and protects it against scratches, wear and chemical attack.
Which solvent should I use with the UV Base Coat?

Corquímica always recommends a solvent formulation developed in-house for the UV Base Coat, to best deliver the result the customer expects. Tell us about your process and the team will recommend the solvent.
Which UV base coat should I use on ABS, PP or PS?
Each plastic has a specific base coat. Corquímica offers base coats for ABS, PP, PS, Zamak and TPU. Send a part for testing and the technical team will recommend the version.
Do I need a primer before the base coat?
It depends on the material. On low surface energy plastics such as PP, a primer may be required. The recommendation is made after testing on the part.
How long does the UV base coat take to cure?
UV curing takes seconds, compared with tens of minutes for thermal oven systems. The exact time depends on the lamp and the film thickness.
Is there a UV base coat for TPU?
Yes. The UV Base Coat Flex is our flexible coating for TPU. It follows the part as it flexes. Compatibility with each TPU is confirmed by testing.
Does Corquímica make custom base coats?
Yes. The lab adjusts the formulation to the customer's part, substrate and equipment, with on-site technical support.

verniz-uv-top-coat.short: Protection and gloss over the metallization.
verniz-uv-top-coat.h1: UV Top Coat: protection and gloss for metallized parts
verniz-uv-top-coat.title: UV Top Coat for metallized parts | Corquímica
verniz-uv-top-coat.meta: UV top coat with scratch resistance and a mirror finish for metallized parts. Manufacturer in Estância Velha, RS, Brazil. Request a sample.
verniz-uv-top-coat.def: The UV Top Coat is the final layer applied over the metallized part. It protects the metallization, an extremely thin film, against scratches, wear and chemical agents, and delivers the mirror finish. A flexible version is also available for TPU parts.
verniz-uv-top-coat.prac: After the metallizing chamber, the Top Coat is spray-applied and UV-cured in seconds. The part comes out ready for assembly, with stable gloss and resistance to handling.
feat: High scratch and abrasion resistance
Mirror or matte finish
Protects the metallization against wear and everyday chemicals
Fast UV cure
Options for metallized and tinted parts
Flexible version for TPU that follows the part's movement
Always recommended with a solvent formulated by Corquímica
ben: Fewer complaints about peeling and stains
Compatible with Corquímica UV base coats
table: Protection and gloss over the metallization
UV Top Coat for Painted Parts
Protection and gloss over painted parts
faq: What is a UV top coat used for?
It protects the vacuum metallization and provides a gloss or matte finish with scratch resistance.
Can I metallize without a top coat?
It is not recommended. The metallization is a very thin film and is damaged by handling. The Top Coat prevents scratches, stains and loss of gloss.
Which solvent should I use with the UV Top Coat?

Corquímica always recommends a solvent formulation developed in-house for the Top Coat, to best deliver the result the customer expects. Tell us about your process and the team will recommend the solvent.
Can the top coat be tinted?
Yes. With UV colorants the top coat can be tinted to achieve gold, bronze, blue and other colors over the metallized base.
Is the top coat suitable for automotive parts?
It is suitable for the finishing and cosmetic protection of parts and accessories. Exterior performance depends on testing for each project.
What is the difference between a UV top coat and a PU coating?
UV cures in seconds under ultraviolet radiation, with no long oven bake. PU cures by chemical or thermal reaction and usually takes longer. The choice depends on the part and the line.
Is there a top coat for TPU?
Yes. For flexible TPU parts, Corquímica recommends the flexible system: the Base Flex plus a compatible top coat. The combination is validated by testing on the part.
How do I contact sales about the Top Coat?
Message our sales team on WhatsApp with the part material and the effect you want. The team will reply with a recommendation and send a sample.

faq: What is acrylic lacquer?
It is a fast-drying paint with a smooth film, used to give color and gloss to plastics, metals and wood.
Lacquer or UV coating: which should I choose?
Lacquer adds color and dries quickly without UV light. UV coating cures in seconds under the lamp and gives more hardness and gloss. Many lines combine both.
Which solvent should I use with the lacquer?

Corquímica always recommends a solvent formulation developed in-house for each lacquer, to best deliver the result the customer expects. Tell us about your process and the team will recommend the solvent.
Is the lacquer alcohol resistant?
Corquímica lacquers are alcohol resistant. The exact level depends on the line and the cure.
Can you match the color of a sample?
Yes. The lab develops the color from the sample sent by the customer.
Is the lacquer suitable for furniture?
Yes, for furniture accessories, panels and plastic parts. For plastic coverings that need high protection, a UV coating may be recommended on top.
Is the lacquer suitable for cosmetic packaging?
Yes, in solid or metallic colors, with resistance testing against alcohol and the product's fragrance.

faq: Which paint should I use on ABS and PS heels?
Use a paint formulated for these plastics, one that adheres without attacking the heel. Corquímica recommends the system after testing your part.
Which segments are the ABS and PS paints for?
They are used only in fashion, mainly for painting heels, and in general plastics.
Does Corquímica help formulate colors?
Yes. We work alongside the customer's chemists and colorists, supporting color formulation, application and validation.
How long does it take to adjust a shade?
We work quickly, because fashion color demands speed and precision. The lead time depends on the shade and the sample.
Do I need a primer on ABS and PS?

Can I paint and then metallize?

tintas-piso.short: Floor painting and protection, formulated for each application.
tintas-piso.h1: Floor paints: protection and finish for industrial and commercial spaces
tintas-piso.title: Industrial floor paints | Corquímica

tintas-piso.def: Corquímica floor paint is epoxy. It protects and finishes concrete surfaces exposed to traffic, cleaning and chemical agents.
tintas-piso.prac: The floor is prepared, the paint is applied by roller or spray, and the floor is released after the specified cure. The system is chosen according to the foot traffic, forklifts and chemicals in the area.
feat: Resistance to traffic and abrasion
Easy to clean
Custom colors and line marking
Adhesion to concrete
Gloss or satin finish options
faq: Which paint should I use on an industrial floor?
Use a paint with high resistance to traffic and abrasion, chosen according to how the area is used. Corquímica recommends the system after understanding the application.
How long before the floor can be used?
It depends on the resin and the temperature. The technical data sheet gives the cure and return-to-service times.
Do I need to prepare the floor before painting?
Yes. The floor must be clean, dry and free of loose material. Correct preparation has the greatest influence on durability.
Can the paint be anti-slip?
An anti-slip finish can be added, depending on the system.
Can you mark aisles and parking spaces?
Yes, with custom line marking colors.
What is the difference between floor paint and regular paint?
Floor paint has the resin and fillers to withstand abrasion, traffic and cleaning. Regular wall paint peels quickly under those conditions.

corantes-uv.def: UV colorant is the color concentrate mixed into UV-curing coatings or paints. It tints the finish without losing transparency or cure, and makes it possible to create custom colors.
corantes-uv.prac: The colorant is added to the coating in the specified ratio, mixed until homogeneous and applied. This is how a clear Top Coat becomes gold, bronze, blue or red over the metallized part.

Custom colors matched to samples

Guaranteed batch-to-batch stability
ben: Color matching for the customer's collection
Less inventory, since color is made to order
faq: What is a UV colorant?
It is a color concentrate for UV-curing coatings and paints. It tints the film without compromising the cure.
What is the difference between a dye and a pigment?
A dye dissolves in the coating and gives translucent color. A pigment stays in suspension and gives opaque color and hiding power.
Can I tint the Top Coat?
Yes. Adding UV colorant to the Top Coat creates colored finishes over the metallization.
What ratio of colorant goes into the coating?
It varies by product and the intensity you want. The technical data sheet gives the recommended range.
Does Corquímica make custom colors?
Yes. Send a sample and the lab will match the color, with samples for approval.
Does the colorant affect UV curing?
Very intense colors may require adjusting the lamp or the film thickness. Testing on the part determines the adjustment.

For printing part prototypes. It is highly recommended for validating the part before the customer invests in making the mold.

Can a part printed with the 3D resin be metallized?
Yes. Parts printed with Corquímica 3D resins are compatible with our coatings and can be metallized, giving a look closer to the final design.
Can the 3D resin be made in the project color?
Yes. The resin is supplied in the shade the customer wants.
Why prototype before making the mold?
Because a prototype lets you evaluate the part's shape, fit and appearance before investing in the mold, while changes are still simple.

faq: What is the solvent used for on a UV line?
It adjusts the viscosity and flow of the coating for spray application, and influences the final finish of the part.
Can I use any solvent with the UV coating?
It is not recommended. Each UV coating and each lacquer is recommended with a solvent formulation developed by Corquímica, to deliver the expected result.
What is a cleaning degreaser?
It is a product that removes oil, mold release agent and dirt from parts before painting, and also cleans spray guns and equipment.
Do I need to degrease the part before painting?
In most cases, yes. Mold release and grease residues cause peeling and defects. Testing on the part defines the process.
Is the solvent suitable for sensitive plastics such as PS?
It depends on the formulation. PS is sensitive to certain types of solvents, and Corquímica recommends the compatible option.
How do I request a solvent recommendation?
Message our sales team on WhatsApp and tell us which coating or lacquer you use and the part material.
